kind: Prepared native walking plan; not an executed playtest

forwardWaypoints.location: Over ten studs inside platform, before presenter dais

return: Reverse the same waypoints. Only after reaching Z -886, walk sideways to the next path X; do not reposition onto ramp or stage.
setup: Use the actual normal player character with Studio flight off and all root parts unanchored.
Use the existing Studio tools to hold a Lobby phase so a race transition cannot teleport the player mid-check.
Wait until arrival/editor/stage presentation is closed; pause only normal input controls owned by the probe if MoveTo is used.
Set JumpPower and JumpHeight to zero, Jump false, and locally disable the Jumping state for the probe. Record prior values and restore afterward.
Keep the ordinary character WalkSpeed and record it. Infer the actual standing offset from the settled lower-lobby character rather than assuming R6 and R15 have identical hip heights.
A single initial placement inside the lower lobby may prepare the run; record it explicitly. No placement after the forward walking begins.
evidence: Record each forward/return MoveTo completion plus actual root position, health, elapsed time and humanoid state.
Sample movement about every 0.05 seconds, mark Jumping/Freefall/death, and flag abrupt position changes that could be teleports.
At each waypoint, root Y must match expected floor Y plus the settled standing offset within a reasonable walking tolerance.
Record all three round trips and the sideways lower-lobby transitions; preserve the player's original settings and remove only the owned probe.
Capture native player-height views at the lower seam, ramp midpoint and stage join.
limitations: Raycasts, route coordinates and a successful import alone do not establish walking.
The center endpoint intentionally stops before the presenter dais; the test must not confuse climbing its separate lip with entering Grand Arcade.
This is one ordinary avatar and a native local playtest, not device, multiplayer, FPS or complete-race proof.
